role_summary: Lead the Hong Kong Technology Team, serving as the bridge between local business stakeholders, regional leadership, and global technology functions. Responsible for aligning local business needs with global technology standards, driving delivery of technology services, embedding emerging technologies (AI, DLT), managing cyber security and business continuity, supporting regulatory and client due diligence engagements, and leading a diverse local technology team.
must_have_requirements: 10+ years of relevant technology experience in global financial services
Proven leadership experience managing technology teams
Track record delivering large-scale technology, digital transformation, and change management initiatives
Understanding of investment management business processes
Experience aligning local/regional technology delivery with global standards and policies
Experience managing stakeholder relationships with senior business leaders
Knowledge of technology delivery best practices (agile, governance, execution)
Experience supporting regulatory engagements, DDQs, and RFPs
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
nice_to_have_requirements: Awareness of emerging technologies: AI, Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), Quantum Computing
Experience with cyber security and business continuity management in financial services
Experience working within a matrixed global organization
Experience managing diverse, multicultural technology talent
Familiarity with Hong Kong/APAC regulatory environment for financial services

scoring_criteria.name: Financial Services Technology Leadership Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core requirement to lead a regional technology function within global financial services context
evidence_type_to_look_for: Job titles like Head of Technology/IT Director
10+ years tenure in financial services technology
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May lack Hong Kong/APAC-specific market experience

scoring_criteria.name: Large-Scale Technology & Digital Transformation Delivery
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD explicitly requires proven delivery of large-scale transformation and change initiatives

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder & Business Relationship Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role is positioned as a bridge between business, regional, and global teams
evidence_type_to_look_for: examples of managing senior stakeholder relationships

scoring_criteria.name: Alignment of Local Business with Global Technology Standards
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Key responsibility to harmonize local needs with global policy/governance

scoring_criteria.name: Emerging Technology Awareness (AI, DLT, Quantum)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD calls for advocating and embedding AI/DLT/emerging tech into solutions
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Quantum computing exposure likely minimal industry-wide

scoring_criteria.name: Cyber Security & Business Continuity Collaboration
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Explicit responsibility to safeguard cyber security and BCP with global teams

scoring_criteria.name: Regulatory & Client Due Diligence Support (DDQ/RFP)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires seamless handling of regulatory engagements and client RFPs/DDQs

scoring_criteria.name: Talent Management & Team Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD requires managing diverse talent and cultivating agile, problem-solving skills

scoring_criteria.name: Investment Management Domain Knowledge
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Understanding of investment management business processes is explicitly required

scoring_criteria.name: Education & Foundational Qualifications
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Bachelor's degree in relevant technical field is a baseline requirement
evidence_type_to_look_for: degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field

summary_focus: Position as a senior technology leader bridging business and global technology functions in financial services
Highlight large-scale transformation delivery with quantifiable outcomes
Emphasize stakeholder management across regional/global structures
Showcase emerging technology (AI/DLT) advocacy and adoption experience
Reflect regulatory/client engagement exposure (DDQs, RFPs) if applicable
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim direct quantum computing implementation unless explicitly done
Do not overstate Hong Kong/APAC regulatory expertise if experience is elsewhere
Do not inflate team size or scope of transformation programs beyond actual role

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Frame candidate as a bridge-builder who translates global technology strategy into local execution, with strong delivery track record and emerging tech fluency
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking direct APAC/Hong Kong experience, emphasize adaptability and global stakeholder management skills
If limited DLT/quantum exposure, frame as strong awareness and willingness to lead adoption
If DDQ/RFP experience is indirect, highlight related compliance or client-facing technology work
